programName: Information Technology - Game Development and Interactive Media
programDescription: You learn knowledge and skills that help with careers in the gaming, interactive media and simulation industries, or help with being an entrepreneur in charge of developing and managing a gaming/interactive media studio.
admissionCoursesNeeded:
Current Ontario secondary school students must complete the Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD) with
six 4U or 4M credits including English (ENG4U)
and one of Advanced Functions (MHF4U), Calculus and Vectors (MCV4U) or Mathematics of Data Management (MDM4U)
or Computer Science (ICS4U)
interestingFacts:
1. At the end of each year there is a gamecon for students to show what they've worked on
  2. There are many entrepreneurship events for students to partake in
  3. Labs and workshops where students can try different games and can create games are frequent
